pages.text: $(bold)Key Bindings$()$(br2)All PiranPort keys can be customized in Controls > Key Binds.$(br2)$(bold)Fire Control:$()$(br)• $(bold)Middle-click$(): select crosshair target (adds; sneak = replace with single target; sneak with no target = clear)$(br2)$(bold)Weapons & Aircraft:$()$(br)• $(bold)Tab$(): cannon ammo wheel$(br)• $(bold)R$(): manual reload$(br)• $(bold)U$(): toggle fighter ground attack$(br)• $(bold)H$(): auto-launch / auto-AA toggle

$(bold)Recon:$()$(br)• $(bold)V$(): exit recon view (recon view engages automatically on launch)$(br2)Debug mode, cooldown override, hit notifications and log snapshots live on the debug terminal's control page. Registered keys can be rebound in game settings.
